repository.name: hyperflux-next
repository.description: Linux driver that makes Razer devices on a HyperFlux V2 wireless receiver work with OpenRazer, Polychromatic, and OpenRGB.

private_vulnerability_reporting.data_boundary: GitHub private security advisories; never public issue intake

dependabot_security_updates.data_boundary: GitHub dependency alerts and update pull requests

secret_scanning.data_boundary: Repository content scanned by GitHub; no hardware diagnostics

secret_scanning_push_protection.data_boundary: Git pushes checked for supported secret patterns

code_scanning.data_boundary: Source analysis uploaded by the pinned CodeQL workflow

source_sbom.data_boundary: Generated SPDX inventory from reviewed manifests and workflow pins

artifact_attestations.data_boundary: Release artifacts and provenance only; no hardware evidence or private diagnostics

service_evaluations.privacy: Would transmit source-derived coverage metadata to an external service.
service_evaluations.rationale: Local LLVM line coverage is already a gated contract in assurance/rust-coverage.json; a hosted upload service adds no gate and is not selected.

benefits: Native grouped updates for Actions, Cargo, and Python manifests
service_evaluations.privacy: Uses GitHub-native dependency metadata within the repository account.
service_evaluations.rationale: Already modeled with bounded weekly groups and fewer moving parts than an external dependency bot.

service_evaluations.privacy: Publishes or uploads repository posture metadata and is most useful after the project has a stable remote history.
service_evaluations.rationale: Reconsider after the public repository has stable history; native controls already cover the current security boundary.

benefits: Highly configurable dependency grouping and cross-file updates
service_evaluations.privacy: An external app would receive repository metadata and dependency manifests.
service_evaluations.rationale: Its flexibility does not currently outweigh an additional app, credential, policy surface, and duplicate update authority.
